title: W-4: after a public flip CI has no runner; run pull_request jobs on GitHub-hosted runners or guard by head repository
description: Source: the consolidated pre-public security review (opum-doc, 2026-10-30), reviewed at b1dae53374a8c0c3514f015ff77faac9af643e2d; tracked under ODOC-552 and parent WCLI-95. Report id: W-4 (high), ruling W-34. Every CI and release job runs on [self-hosted, Linux, ARM64] and both organisation runner groups have allows_public_repositories false, so after a flip Check, Docs and Tracker integrity never report and every PR to dev blocks. Ruling W-34: A. GitHub-hosted runners, or a head-repository guard, for pull_request jobs; self-hosted runners stay for trusted refs; require approval for outside collaborators; never set allows_public_repositories true, which is a security relaxation and not ours to make. The ARM64 macOS release build cannot be hosted. CI workflow and required-check change: renaming or removing a job means updating ruleset 24097150 in the same change. Needs Opus review.

acceptanceCriteria.text: pull_request jobs run on GitHub-hosted runners or are guarded by a head-repository check; self-hosted capacity is used only for trusted refs
The three required contexts (Check, Docs, Tracker integrity) still report on a pull request, and the ruleset is updated in the same change if any job is renamed
Require approval for all outside collaborators is set before the flip (operator-owned setting)
allows_public_repositories stays false on every runner group

implementationNotes: Scope, for WCLI-123: the merged change (opum-ai/ward-cli#237) also moves release.yml build and release to unconditional hosted ubuntu-24.04-arm, beyond the pull_request jobs this task was filed for. WCLI-123 depends on it.

Landed: opum-ai/ward-cli#237 (squash a506148, 2026-11-01), Opus APPROVE at c6d3395 round 2 after APPROVE at ce4f6a6. Measured by the leader: delta exactly 5 files, job names in ci.yml and release.yml identical to base, clean 45 of 45 in a scratch copy, macos-14 on the verify line turns exactly 3 red and self-hosted on build turns exactly 2 red; CI Check, Docs and Tracker integrity green on hosted ubuntu-24.04-arm; release.yml workflow_dispatch dry run on the PR head succeeded (build hosted, verify on the private arm, release skipped). AC1 and AC2 are evidenced by that CI run. AC3 (Require approval for all outside collaborators) and AC4 (allows_public_repositories false on every runner group) are operator settings in the sitting and are NOT ticked here. Finding 3 for the sitting script: re-running a pre-flip run after the flip keeps private true and queues forever; dispatch fresh or tag anew.

Ticked AC1 and AC2 at 2026-11-01 on landed evidence, opum-ai/ward-cli#237 squash a506148. AC1: every ci.yml job and release.yml build and release run on GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04-arm, asserted per job by test/ci-hardening.test.ts and test/release-workflow.test.ts; the only self-hosted label left is verify keyed expression. AC2: CI run 41324825051 on c6d3395 passed Check, Docs and Tracker integrity on the hosted runner, job names unchanged from base, so the ruleset needed no update. AC3 and AC4 stay open for the sitting.

AC3 closed 2026-11-02 by substitution: the API policy fork-pr-contributor-approval reads all_external_contributors (gh api repos/opum-ai/ward-cli/actions/permissions/fork-pr-contributor-approval, read after the flip), replacing the settings-page click per the team-lead brief. AC4 closed: gh api orgs/opum-ai/actions/runner-groups shows allows_public_repositories false on both groups, Default and mbpm2.
finalSummary: W-4 closed: every CI and release job runs on GitHub-hosted Linux ARM64 (#237); fork-pr-contributor-approval is all_external_contributors (API, replacing the settings click) and allows_public_repositories is false on both runner groups, read by ref after the public flip.
